translations.zh: 澤王琅邪二年，而太后崩，澤乃曰：「帝少，諸呂用事，諸劉孤弱。」
translations.literal: In the second year of Liu Ze's reign as king of Langye, the empress dowager died. Ze said, "The emperor is young, the Lü clan holds power, and the Liu are isolated and weak."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Liu Ze's reign as king of Langye, the empress dowager died. Ze said, "The emperor is young, the Lü clan holds power, and the Liu are isolated and weak."

translations.zh: 引兵與齊王合謀西，欲誅諸呂。
translations.literal: He led his troops to join the King of Qi in plotting a westward march to execute the Lü.
translations.idiomatic: He led his troops to join the King of Qi in plotting a westward march to execute the Lü.

translations.zh: 至梁，聞漢灌將軍屯滎陽，澤還兵備西界，遂跳驅至長安。
translations.literal: Reaching Liang, he heard that General Guan Ying of Han was encamped at Xingyang. Ze turned his army to guard the western frontier and dashed post-haste to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Liang, he heard that General Guan Ying of Han was encamped at Xingyang. Ze turned his army to guard the western frontier and dashed post-haste to Chang'an.

translations.literal: The King of Dai also came from Dai.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Dai also came from Dai.

translations.zh: 諸將相與琅邪王共立代王，是為孝文帝。
translations.literal: The generals and ministers together with the king of Langye enthroned the King of Dai, who became Emperor Wen of Han.
translations.idiomatic: The generals and ministers together with the king of Langye enthroned the King of Dai, who became Emperor Wen of Han.

translations.zh: 文帝元年，徙澤為燕王，而復以琅邪歸齊。
translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Wen, Ze was transferred to be king of Yan, and Langye was returned to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Wen, Ze was transferred to be king of Yan, and Langye was returned to Qi.

translations.zh: 澤王燕二年，薨，諡曰敬王。
translations.literal: In the second year of Ze's reign as king of Yan, he died; his posthumous title was King Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Ze's reign as king of Yan, he died; his posthumous title was King Jing.

translations.literal: His son King Kang Jia succeeded him; after nine years he died.
translations.idiomatic: His son King Kang Jia succeeded him; after nine years he died.

translations.zh: 定國與父康王姬姦，生子男一人。
translations.literal: Dingguo committed incest with his father King Kang's concubine and had one male child.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo committed incest with his father King Kang's concubine and had one male child.

translations.literal: He seized his younger brother's wife as a concubine.
translations.idiomatic: He seized his younger brother's wife as a concubine.

translations.literal: He committed incest with three of his children.
translations.idiomatic: He committed incest with three of his children.

translations.zh: 定國有所欲誅殺臣肥如令郢人，郢人等告定國。
translations.literal: Dingguo wished to execute his minister Ying, magistrate of Feiru. The people of Ying and others reported Dingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo wished to execute his minister Ying, magistrate of Feiru. The people of Ying and others reported Dingguo.

translations.zh: 定國使謁者以它法劾捕格殺郢人滅口。
translations.literal: Dingguo sent an usher to impeach and arrest Ying on another charge and beat him to death to silence him.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo sent an usher to impeach and arrest Ying on another charge and beat him to death to silence him.

translations.zh: 至元朔中，郢人昆弟復上書具言定國事。
translations.literal: In the Yuanshuo era, the brothers of the man from Ying again submitted a memorial detailing Dingguo's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanshuo era, the brothers of the man from Ying again submitted a memorial detailing Dingguo's crimes.

translations.zh: 下公卿，皆議曰：「定國禽獸行，亂人倫，逆天道，當誅。」
translations.literal: The case went to the lords and ministers, who all deliberated: "Dingguo's conduct is that of a beast; he disorders human relations, violates Heaven's Way, and should be executed."
translations.idiomatic: The case went to the lords and ministers, who all deliberated: "Dingguo's conduct is that of a beast; he disorders human relations, violates Heaven's Way, and should be executed."

translations.zh: 定國自殺，立四十二年，國除。
translations.literal: Dingguo killed himself. The state had stood forty-two years and was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo killed himself. The state had stood forty-two years and was abolished.

translations.zh: 哀帝時繼絕世，乃封敬王澤玄孫之孫無終公士歸生為營陵侯，更始中為兵所殺。
translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Ai, to continue a severed line, Ze's great-great-grandson through King Jing, Gui Sheng, a gentleman of Wuzhong, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yingling; in the Gengshi era he was killed by soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Ai, to continue a severed line, Ze's great-great-grandson through King Jing, Gui Sheng, a gentleman of Wuzhong, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yingling; in the Gengshi era he was killed by soldiers.
